summary: This configuration file sets up environment variables for a Docker container running a Python application. It defines the application directory path, container identification, Linux user/group IDs for permission management, and the Python version to use.

explanations.8: The value 1000 here is not actually root—root is 0. This sets up a non-root user with ID 1000, which is a security best practice for containers.
explanations.11: Similar to the group ID, this creates a user with ID 1000 inside the container; matching these IDs helps avoid file permission issues between the container and your host machine.
explanations.14: The username 'python' is the actual name of the user account that will be created inside the container with the ID specified on line 11.
